customer_updates.name: Kunal Telgote
customer_updates.text:
The test center is good and quite professional.
Use *Knight Fintech Research Private Limited* as the drop location as suggested by others.
The center is quite cold so wear thermals as they don't allow sweaters or jackets.
For some exams they do allow transparent water bottle, for GRE they don't allow anything except for the passport.
They do allow washroom breaks but only when the timer is running during the sections. Everytime they thoroughly do the body scan. Plan accordingly.
They keyboard was not that good. So practise beforehand on a keyboard instead of laptop.
They provide a rough sheet(4 pages), can ask for more. The pencil is light and the paper is greenish, so it is difficult to see what we have written on the paper.
Washroom is OK.
They do provide locker.
